title: Check run
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant caller as Caller
  participant n0 as Check run
  caller->>n0: Check an instance
  alt a pin disagrees (INV-K2, INV-K3, INV-K4)
    n0--)caller: Run refused
  else the pins agree
    n0--)caller: Instance checked
  end
  caller->>n0: Check the form
  caller->>n0: Check a range of ids
  caller->>n0: Check a range of commits
